""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Extracting actual descriptions from adjacent elements will increase completeness # MECHANISM-1: Most documentation has descriptions in p, dd, or div elements following function signatures # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.40 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.325) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Deduplicating functions by name will improve accuracy # MECHANISM-2: Multiple extraction methods create duplicates that dilute correct entries # EXPECT-2: accuracy > 0.78 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.7222222222222222) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") func_dict = {} # Use dict to deduplicate by name # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (most structured) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Look for description in next dd element desc = "No description found" next_dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") if next_dd: desc_text = next_dd.get_text(strip=True) if desc_text: desc = desc_text[:200] # Limit description length func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), } # 2. Look for function signatures in headers for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name not in func_dict: # Look for description in next sibling desc = "No description found" next_elem = block.find_next_sibling(["p", "div"]) if next_elem: desc_text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if desc_text: desc = desc_text[:200] func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 3. Look for code blocks as fallback code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in func_dict: # Look for description in parent's next sibling desc = "No description found" parent = block.parent if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling(["p", "div"]) if next_elem: desc_text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if desc_text: desc = desc_text[:200] func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(func_dict.values())[:20] def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Extract parameter information from a function signature.""" params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Split by comma but respect nested parentheses param_parts = [p.strip() for p in param_string.split(",")] for part in param_parts: if part and part not in ["self", "cls"]: # Extract name and default if "=" in part: name, default = part.split("=", 1) name = name.strip() default = default.strip() else: name = part.split(":")[0].strip() default = None # Extract type hint if present param_type = "unknown" if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":", 1)[1].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = type_part params.append({ "name": name, "type": param_type, "default": default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
